cases.name: Mabel Agnes "Mae" Boyer Herman
cases.about: She was born 5/8/1900 and was a part of a sewing circle and a lifelong member of Vinje Lutheran Church.
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE SOLVED; INCOMPETENT / UNFIT TO STAND TRIAL
cases.narrative: On 1/27/1974, her sister found her fully clothed body lying in the middle of her living room. Autopsy revealed she had been stabbed 38 times in the chest, abdomen and neck.
